item.description: We present PhysInsert, a framework for physically plausible reference-based object insertion that jointly adapts objects and their surrounding scenes. We construct the Insert World dataset with strictly aligned Blender-rendered counterfactual pairs and object references across viewpoints and lighting conditions. item.title: Ask HN: Are you tired too in this AI era?
item.description:
Although AI lets us do much more, I feel considerably more tired than before.

We need to keep track of many things happening in parallel and read enormous amounts of generated text. The constant guardrailing, decision making, and context switching overload me.

I am pretty sure most of you are experiencing the same as me, but: Have you found ways of using AI without increasing mental overload?

I would love to hear your tips, but still be relevant in this AI era, so my boss does not fire me. — 来源：arxiv · reddit_ml · github · verge_ai · hackernews — 原文：https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50301479

item.title: Agentic LLM reasoning in pediatric diabetes outcome prediction from multimodal medical records
item.description: Large language model (LLM) agents are proposed for clinical prediction but are untested in pediatrics, where cohorts are small and outcomes are uncommon. item.description: Sampling-based reachability estimates reachable sets from finitely many simulated trajectory endpoints. item.title: socx: GPU-Accelerated Chance-Constrained Stochastic Optimal Control using JAX
item.description: In this article, we present socx, a GPU-accelerated solver for lifted convex reformulations of linear stochastic optimal control under chance constraints, implemented in JAX. item.description: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations.
